features.title: Audio Narration Speech Synthesis and Variable Pacing Engine
acceptance: Synthesize offline deterministic RIFF/WAVE PCM audio tracks for deck speaker notes with multiple voices (narrator-en, narrator-exec, narrator-tech, narrator-calm) and configurable speech pacing (80-300 WPM)
Provide standalone CLI (python -m backend.app.services.audio_narration) with fail-closed diagnostics, --out, and --json reporting
Expose REST API endpoints /api/decks/{id}/narration/synthesize and /api/decks/{id}/narration/audio with words_per_minute parameter
Support UI narration player, WPM pace selector, and audio download in DeckDetail.tsx
Maintain first-party source code strictly within 50,000–150,000 bytes budget and pass preflight inspection

features.title: Smart Layout and Auto-Alignment Engine for PPTX Export
acceptance: Calculate dynamic bounding boxes and proportional typography scaling based on bullet text density for complex shapes during PPTX generation
